senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַר; cmp. Hif. הֵפֵר) one who breaks his promise, perfidious.—Pl. פּוֹרָנִים.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 320:5">Sifré Deut. 320</cite> (synonymous with <cite ref="E00746"><he>הֲפַכְפְּכָן</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 945">Yalk. ib. 945</cite> <he>פרדנין</he> (some ed. <cite ref="M02554"><he>מרדנין</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
